g.text: Lab 2.2 — Secure Access: Bastion, NSG, ASG
No public IP on any workload VM · NSG rules stop at the first match
AzureBastionSubnet 10.0.0.0/26 in the hub · no NSG on that subnet
reaches dev and prod over the hub-to-* peering
2 · NSG rule evaluation — first match wins
Lower number wins. Evaluation stops at the first match.
3 · ASG — rules by role, not by IP
# edit the rule on every new VM
# the VM joins the ASG, rule follows
asg-auth · asg-world · asg-db — membership is a property of the VM NIC, not the subnet
az CLI — the priority number is the whole game
# custom range 100-4096 · lower is evaluated first
the other two packets, same ladder
no NSG attached to that subnet
reaches spokes over the hub peering
